_about: Hub-provided files in agent workspaces that improve over time. A workspace copy byte-identical to one of the 'previous' versions (sha256) was never edited, so the hub replaces it with the current template at startup; any other copy is the owner's and stays. When a listed template changes, move its old 'current' into 'previous' and set the new 'current' (test/setup-interview-resume.test.js checks this).
